fields.Name: T185 - App Roles Add Role Assignment
fields.Description: Exercises AddRole()/GetUnassignedRoles()/SelectedRoleIdToAdd — the in-memory role-assignment add path unique to the App Roles matrix, separate from any grid add.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'App Roles' sub-section. Expand any application accordion panel. At the bottom of the expanded panel there is a 'Select a role to add...' dropdown and an 'Add Role' button (disabled until a role is chosen). Pick an unassigned role from the dropdown, then click 'Add Role', and verify a new role row is added to that application's table (marked with a 'new' badge) and the 'Unsaved changes' state appears. Do NOT save. Success is the new role row appearing. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Expanding an app panel shows a role-select dropdown with an 'Add Role' button that is disabled until a role is selected
Selecting a role and clicking Add Role inserts a new role row (with a 'new' indicator) into that application's assignments
An unsaved-changes indicator appears after adding the role
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
